messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: private-vpc/cedar-prod — NLB 'cedar-edge-nlb' returning >=50% 503 responses for tenant cedarcorp. Severity: P1. Pager sent to oncall.

sara (oncall): ack — joining now. Paging details in incident console.

jon (sre): I'm on metrics/dashboard. NLB healthy count dropping, target group 'tg-cedar-app' showing lots of Unhealthy.

deepak (network): adding network team. quick glance: healthchecks failing with ECONNREFUSED from the NLB to backend ips.

emily (eng-platform): any recent deploys or config changes to SGs/NLB?

julie (acct): customer (Julie@cedarcorp) reporting errors across their API, they started seeing failures ~2024-05-03T08:45Z.

sara (oncall): pulling target health now, one sec.

jon (sre): paste: ```
$ aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:...:targetgroup/tg-cedar-app/abcd1234
TargetHealthDescriptions: 
 - 20 targets: 10 healthy, 10 unhealthy (reason: connection-refused)
```

deepak (network): I can see a security-group change in config audit at 07:58 UTC referencing sg-0abcde78 attached to the app subnet. Rule removing inbound from NLB healthcheck CIDR 10.100.0.0/22.

emily (eng-platform): that'd explain it — healthchecks blocked -> targets marked unhealthy -> NLB returns 503.

sara (oncall): @deploy-bot any recent infra changes?

deploy-bot: change-event: chg-2024-05-03-0912 - removed temporary open rule on sg-0abcde78 (author: infra-rotations).

jon (sre): ok rollback SG to previous state, then monitor target health. I'll prepare the CLI.

sara (oncall): doing sg rollback now. applying rule to allow NLB healthcheck CIDR back on 80/443.

emily (eng-platform): sg rollback snippet (testing locally first):
```
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-0abcde78 --protocol tcp --port 80 --cidr 10.100.0.0/22
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-0abcde78 --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 10.100.0.0/22
```

deploy-bot: sg rollback applied: sg-0abcde78 updated (change-id chg-2024-05-03-0912-rollback).

jon (sre): checking target health after rollback...

jon (sre): initial flurry: 6/20 healthy -> 12/20 healthy within 30s. latency down, 503 rate dropping.

sara (oncall): good. initiate slow traffic shift to fallback ALB to reduce blast radius while we watch. Route53 weighted policy to move 30% traffic to 'cedar-fallback-alb'.

emily (eng-platform): I'll stage the Route53 change:
```
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z123456 --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.cedar.internal.","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"cedar-fallback","Weight":30,"AliasTarget":{"HostedZoneId":"ZALB...","DNSName":"cedar-fallback-alb-123.elb.amazonaws.com","EvaluateTargetHealth":false}}}]}'
```

deploy-bot: Route53 change submitted (change-id ZR-2024-05-03-0918).

julie (acct): notifying cedarcorp: "we're mitigating — rolling back a config change and shifting a portion of traffic to fallback. We'll follow up with RCA."

kevin (customer): thanks, we'll keep our oncall ready. any ETA to full recovery?

sara (oncall): short term: monitoring for 15m. if targets remain stable we'll restore 100% in 30-45m.

deepak (network): follow-up: we should isolate tenant traffic to a dedicated target group/pool to avoid cross-tenant exposure. propose creating a tenant-specific TG and update NLB listener rules. That prevents a bad SG change on other tenants from affecting cedarcorp.

emily (eng-platform): agreed. schedule as follow-up change with canary. For now we'll keep weighted routing + sg guardrails.

jon (sre): health now 18/20 healthy, 503s down ~95% in last 2m. logs show healthcheck retries decreasing.

sara (oncall): creating internal incident ticket INC-1719998888 and assigning to network + platform for RCA.

sara (oncall): customer-facing note sent by @julie. cc'ing support and solutions.

julie (acct): paste customer message we sent: "We're sorry for the disruption. We've reverted a recent config change that blocked healthchecks and shifted some traffic to a fallback endpoint. We're monitoring and will send a full RCA within 48 hours."

kevin (customer): appreciated. please include timeline and root cause when ready.

emily (eng-platform): proposed immediate follow-ups:
- create tenant-dedicated target group and listener rule
- add automatic SG reapply guard for NLB healthcheck CIDR (in infra-guard)
- increase healthcheck timeout from 3s -> 5s to reduce flapping

jon (sre): also recommend a short TTL (30s) for Route53 during mitigation windows so we can roll back quickly; we'll restore to normal after RCA.

deepak (network): taking ownership of tenant isolation change. ETA 2 business days for safe rollout.

sara (oncall): moving to mitigated state. monitoring for 30m. handing off watch to jon.

jon (sre): taking 30m watch. will escalate if error rate >1% or targets drop below 90% healthy.

incident-bot: handoff logged: oncall_prev=sara (1719998888), oncall_next=jon (1719999123).

sara (oncall): thanks team — great quick coordinated work. leaving notes in the incident ticket and linking CloudTrail + SG diff for RCA.

julie (acct): customer confirmed errors decreased to acceptable level. scheduling RCA follow-up call tomorrow with cedarcorp.

incident-bot: incident status changed: MITIGATED (monitoring). will auto-close if no regression within 30m.

jon (sre): closing live thread here; continuing monitoring in ticket INC-1719998888.

deploy-bot: audit: actions performed: sg rollback, Route53 weighted change, healthcheck updates (proposed).
